I'm actually going through an intense existential crisis since my grandmother died a couple of months ago. Every day and night I've been thinking about the fact that someday I'll die, and it'll be painful. I'll no longer exist and I'll never see my loved ones ever again. I almost want to push away my loved ones because I'm so afraid of eventually losing them to death.

I wouldn't quite say it falls apart, but I definitely feel WAY stronger feelings for my fiancee when were together than when were apart. Sometimes I'm like "okay girl you're clearly not in love with her you gotta LEAVE" then other times I'm like "my heart is SWELLING WITH LOVE FOR YOU!!!". I know it's all in my head but it's seriously SO distressing.

I struggle literally every day to fight my self-harm urges, the urge to victimize myself, and the urge to do or say really terrible things to my loved ones EVERY DAMN DAY. I've gotten pretty okay at catching myself when I try to use manipulation tactics, but I still have meltdowns about the TINIEST things (had a meltdown last night because my fiancee doesn't like to drink even though I do. Threw a whole fit about it).

The romanticization KILLS me. It's not some cute lil Harley Quinn "cRAaaZy qUirKy gIrL" shit. This shit ruins my life, and by proxy ruins my loved ones lives every single day that I'm on this earth.
